## Teaching points

1. Start empiric IV antibiotics promptly in suspected neutropenic sepsis. An unimpressive local examination can accompany serious infection.
2. Treat suspected neutropenic sepsis as an emergency; obtain cultures without delaying effective IV antibiotics.
3. ANC is approximately 0.11 × 10^9/L from WBC 0.6 and neutrophils 18%. A clean port site does not exclude bloodstream infection.
4. The engine shares a carbapenem response tag between meropenem and ertapenem. Physiological response is therefore not evidence of appropriate spectrum; the treatment checklist accepts only antipseudomonal agents.
